experiment: Nine full-scale vacuum-chamber uplift tests were run on pairs of 20-ft laterally unsupported C- and Z-purlins with tension flanges through-fastened to 26-gage roof panels, and the measured failure loads were compared with Cornell-method computed capacities, supplemented by F-tests of the panel-to-purlin rotational restraint.
title: Full-Scale Uplift Tests of Laterally Unsupported C- and Z-Purlins with Through-Fastened Roof Panels

variables.definition: Sequential number identifying each of the nine full-scale uplift test specimens.
variables.evidence: Table 1 p.4, Table 2 p.5, Table S1 pp.4-6
variables.name: Test number

variables.definition: Cross-section shape of the purlin, reported as C or Z.
variables.evidence: Table 1 p.4, Table 3 p.6, Table S1 pp.4-6
variables.name: Purlin section shape

variables.definition: Combined thickness-and-shape designation (e.g. '.07 C') used in Table 2 to group specimens for averaging.
variables.evidence: Table 2 p.5, section_type column
variables.name: Specimen group designation
variables.note: Same column name as the shape column but holds a thickness+shape label

variables.definition: Measured base metal thickness of the purlin steel, excluding coating.
variables.evidence: Table 1 p.4 (t_in), Table 3 p.6, Table S1 pp.4-6
variables.name: Purlin base metal thickness

variables.definition: Measured overall web depth of the purlin cross section as defined in Fig. 1.
variables.evidence: Table 1 p.4 (h_in), Table S1 pp.4-6 (depth_in)
variables.name: Overall web depth

variables.definition: Measured width of flange 1 of the purlin, per the Fig. 1 notation.
variables.evidence: Table 1 p.4
variables.name: Flange 1 width

variables.definition: Measured width of flange 2 of the purlin, per the Fig. 1 notation.
variables.evidence: Table 1 p.4
variables.name: Flange 2 width

variables.definition: Measured length of the edge stiffener lip on flange 1, per Fig. 1.
variables.evidence: Table 1 p.4
variables.name: Edge stiffener 1 length

variables.definition: Measured length of the edge stiffener lip on flange 2, per Fig. 1.
variables.evidence: Table 1 p.4
variables.name: Edge stiffener 2 length

variables.definition: Initial lateral sweep (out-of-straightness offset) of the purlin, negative to the north and positive to the south.
variables.evidence: Table 1 p.4, Note (5)
variables.name: Initial sweep
variables.note: Sign convention is directional, not magnitude-only

variables.definition: Inside corner radius of all purlin bends, stated as a single value for all specimens.
variables.evidence: Table 1 Note (2) p.4; repeated in Table S1 notes
variables.name: Corner radius
variables.note: Single value 0.313 in for all specimens

variables.definition: Inclination of the edge stiffener lips relative to the flange, stated as 90 degrees for all specimens.
variables.evidence: Table 1 Note (3) p.4; repeated in Table S1 notes
variables.name: Edge stiffener angle

variables.definition: Measured yield stress of the purlin steel, reported as a single value of 64.47 ksi applied to all specimens.
variables.evidence: Table 1 Note (4) p.4; column yield_stress_ksi in Table S1
variables.name: Yield stress
variables.note: Same value for all nine tests

variables.definition: Maximum uniform uplift line load carried by the purlin at failure, converted from the maximum vacuum-chamber transducer pressure using the tributary width.
variables.evidence: Table 2 p.5 (pu_lb_per_ft); Table S1 failure_load_as_printed
variables.name: Tested failure load
variables.note: Report does not state whether dead load is included

variables.definition: Unit in which the maximum failure load is printed (lb/ft).
variables.evidence: Table S1 column failure_load_unit
variables.name: Failure load unit

variables.definition: Group mean of the tested failure loads for each thickness-and-shape group, printed as interleaved 'Average' rows in Table 2.
variables.evidence: Table 2 p.5 'Average' rows; values restated in Table S1 notes (.07 C = 102.2, .07 Z = 126.7, .10 C = 204.0, .10 Z = 239.3 lb/ft)
variables.name: Group average tested load
variables.note: Reported only per group, not per test

variables.definition: Failure load predicted for each specimen using the Cornell analytical method for laterally unsupported purlins.
variables.evidence: Table 2 p.5; Table S1 computed_load_pc_lb_per_ft
variables.name: Computed failure load (Cornell)

variables.definition: Ratio of the tested maximum uplift load to the Cornell-method computed failure load.
variables.evidence: Table 2 p.5 (header printed 'P u/P /c'); Table S1 ratio_pu_pc
variables.name: Test-to-computed load ratio
variables.note: Header printed in broken two-line form

variables.definition: Identification number (1 to 4) of each panel-to-purlin F-test configuration.
variables.evidence: Table 3 p.6
variables.name: F-test configuration number

variables.definition: Rotational restraint of the panel-to-purlin connection measured by the F-test procedure of Reference 2 for each purlin thickness and shape configuration.
variables.evidence: Table 3 p.6; carried per configuration into Table S1
variables.name: Rotational restraint factor
variables.note: Reported per configuration (two F-tests each), not per full-scale test

variables.definition: Number of replicate F-tests performed for each panel-to-purlin configuration, stated as two.
variables.evidence: Table 3 Note (1) p.6
variables.name: F-tests per configuration

variables.definition: Direction of the applied load, simulated wind uplift produced by the vacuum chamber.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column load_direction
variables.name: Load direction

variables.definition: Length of each test purlin, 20 ft for all specimens.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column span_ft; Table 1 note 'two 20-ft long purlins'
variables.name: Purlin span length
variables.note: Number of spans is not stated in the report

variables.definition: Number of parallel purlin lines in each test specimen, two for all tests.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column n_purlin_lines; Table 1 note
variables.name: Number of purlin lines

variables.definition: Description of the roof panel and its attachment: 26-gage conventional through-fastened roof panel screwed to the tension flange.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column panel_type; Table 3 Notes (2) and (3)
variables.name: Roof panel type and attachment
variables.note: Panel gage and fastener type (1/4 x 14 SDS) stated in Table 3 notes

variables.definition: Lateral bracing condition of the purlin compression flange, laterally unsupported for all tests.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column bracing
variables.name: Lateral bracing condition

variables.definition: Tributary width per purlin line used to convert chamber pressure to line load, 38 in. (76-in. chamber shared by two purlin lines).
variables.evidence: Conversion note printed under Table 2: P(lb/ft) = reading (psf) x (76/2) x (1/12)
variables.name: Tributary width per purlin
variables.note: Given only in the load-conversion formula

variables.definition: Report location (table and PDF page) from which each reported failure load was taken.
variables.evidence: Table S1 columns value_source and pages
variables.name: Value source and page
variables.note: Provenance metadata, not a physical quantity
